content.body:
Popularized by American gangsters from its introduction in 1919, the Thompson was militarized in several versions. The British used the M1928 version, but in the later part of the war, US forces used the M1A1, which had a simplified sight and replaced the forward pistol grip with a simple wooden stock. It fired a powerful .45 cal round, which could be effective out to around 100 yards.
Although heavy for an infantry firearm, it was well-balanced and easy to aim. The Thompson was a distinctive weapon which was used worldwide throughout the 40s, 50s, and even well into the 1960s.
